definitions.eligibility: >=5 minutes played; >=5 prior games this season and >=5 overall; opponent with >=5 prior games; regular season (game_id prefix 002, NBA Cup group/knockout included, Cup final excluded)
definitions.baselines: std = prior season-to-date mean PTS (primary); l10 = mean PTS of the last <=10 prior games (chronological, can span the previous season's end)
definitions.events: x125/x150/x200: PTS >= 1.25/1.5/2.0 x baseline; p5/p10: PTS >= baseline + 5/10; z15: (PTS - baseline)/prior SD >= 1.5 (prior SD over the same window: std needs >=5 prior games this season, l10 needs a full 10; SD > 0.5)
definitions.floors: prior average >= floor; floors 8 (default), 12, 5 and none (>0). Sensitivity tables carry every floor
definitions.weak_last: last game < 0.75 x prior season-to-date average; last2 = both of the last 2 games below 0.75x; l3mean = mean of last 3 below 0.75x; hot_last1 >= 1.25x; bignight_last1 >= 1.5x; hot_l5 = last-5 mean >= 1.15x; cold_l5 < 0.85x
definitions.opp_tiers: as-of season-to-date opponent DRtg rank (teams with >=5 games strictly before the date): worst5/worst6_10/middle/best6_10/best5; pace tiers likewise (fastest..slowest)
definitions.opp_form: opponent DRtg over its last 5 (or last 1) games minus its season-to-date DRtg, all prior games; leaky = >= +3 (l5) / +10 (l1), tight = <= -3 / -10
definitions.teammates_out: a teammate is a REGULAR if before the game: >=5 GP with the team this season, in >=50% of the team's games, >=20 min per game played. 'Out' = inactive list, or DNP for a non-coach reason (injury / illness / rest / personal / suspension / not with team); DNP-coach's-decision is not counted. Vacuum size = sum of the out regulars' prior PPG: none / <10 / 10-20 / 20+. Known at about tip-off (inactive list), not days ahead for late scratches
definitions.minutes_role: min_up3 / min_dn3: last-5 minutes >= / <= 3 vs season average; role_promoted = started >=2 of last 3 while season start rate < 50%; role_demoted = started 0 of last 3 with season start rate >= 50%
definitions.season_phase: early Oct-Nov, mid Dec-Feb, late Mar-Apr; cup_game = NBA Cup group or knockout game (game_meta.game_type)
definitions.lens_B: same game, explains the night and is NOT predictive: minutes +5, FGA +4, FTA +3, 3PA +3, usage +5 pts, TS% +-10 pts vs prior; overtime (team minutes > 48.5); margin/blowout (15+) / close (<=5); combined score; opposing starter with >=5 fouls (box-score PF); exact log decomposition pts = minutes x shot rate x efficiency
definitions.thin_events: cells with < 30 events get no lifts; logistic needs >= 60 events; AUC scoring needs >= 30 train and >= 15 test events; a lift is 'reportable' only if the cell and the level are not thin and the level and reference each have >= 10 events
definitions.test_split: date-based: last ~20% of dates per timespan (same cut-offs as points_drivers / matchups / deep); segment membership from train-period PPG ranks
definitions.boosting: LightGBM on the pregame inputs, early stopping on the last 15% of train dates; kept (and SHAP computed) only if AUC gain >= 0.005 with paired player-cluster bootstrap CI above 0, log-loss CI below 0 and lower Brier than the pregame logistic
